names: UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision
summary: UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision, a 347,500-sq-ft, 12-story eye-care tower (with a 5-story south wing and a garden-topped 3-story north wing) at 490 Illinois Street in Mission Bay, opened November 2020 at a reported construction cost of about $237 million; designed by SmithGroup, with fundraising led by the nonprofit That Man May See.

milestones.text: UCSF opens the Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois Street

facts.value: 347,500 across three connected buildings (12-story tower, 5-story south wing, 3-story north wing) plus ~75,000 sq ft of parking for 200+ vehicles
